# MeowKit

> MeowKit is a kit of agents, skills, rules and hooks for AI coding agents. One authored kit installs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Pi and OMP with `mewkit init --target`. It gives the agent a seven-phase workflow, and one hook refuses a commit or push when lint, the related tests or the type-check fail.

## Quick Start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ngocsangyem/MeowKit/main/install.sh | sh
mewkit init
```

## Key Resources

- [Homepage](https://meowkit.dev)
- [Documentation](https://docs.meowkit.dev)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ngocsangyem/MeowKit)
- [Releases](https://github.com/ngocsangyem/MeowKit/releases)

## What MeowKit Does

MeowKit gives AI coding agents a 7-phase workflow:

1. **Orient**: Classify the task, assign a model tier
2. **Plan**: For a non-trivial task, write a plan under `tasks/plans/` and agree it with you
3. **Test**: Write failing tests first (opt-in with `--tdd`)
4. **Build**: Implement against the plan, then Simplify and Verify
5. **Review**: A reviewer writes a verdict across five dimensions: correctness, maintainability, performance, security, coverage
6. **Ship**: Commit, push and open a pull request
7. **Reflect**: Record decisions and gotchas in memory

## Key Features

- **Ship check**: On `git commit`, `git push`, `git merge` and `gh pr create|merge`, a hook runs lint on the changed files, the tests related to them and a type-check, and refuses the command when one fails
- **Credential guard**: Blocks reads of `.env`, key and credential files; scope differs per runtime
- **Planning and review are practices**: No hook blocks an edit without a plan or a commit without a review verdict
- **Evidence, not approval**: Test results, review verdicts and agent advice are things you read; none of them approves anything
- **127 Skills, 42 Agents**: Activates only what each task needs
- **Six runtimes**: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Pi and OMP; Grok, Pi and OMP install at project scope only and their enforcement has not been run in a live session yet
- **Team memory**: Decisions and gotchas live in two committed markdown files
- **MIT Licensed**

## Installation

```bash
# Install the mewkit binary (mk is a short alias); Windows: see docs.meowkit.dev/installation
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ngocsangyem/MeowKit/main/install.sh | sh

# Initialize MeowKit in your project
mewkit init

# Set up Python skills and optional deps (ImageMagick, FFmpeg, Playwright)
mewkit setup

# Verify environment
mewkit doctor
```

## Requirements

- Node.js 24+ (for the kit's hooks; the mewkit binary needs none)
- One of the supported coding agents
- Git
